summary.text: Raumesh Akbari is a Democratic state senator from Memphis who represents Tennessee Senate District 29 in part of Shelby County and is listed as the incumbent candidate in the 2026 election.
An attorney, she chairs the Senate Democratic Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Raumesh Akbari was born on April 14, 1984.
She earned a B.A. from Washington University in St. Louis in 2006 and a J.D. from Saint Louis University School of Law in 2009, and she is an attorney.
Akbari served in the Tennessee House of Representatives from the 108th through the 110th General Assemblies and has been a member of the Senate since the 111th.
She is second vice-chair of the Senate Education Committee and a member of the Commerce and Labor, Calendar and Ethics committees.
She previously chaired the Tennessee Black Caucus of State Legislators and is a board member of the National Civil Rights Museum.
